headline: Soft quarter, yet a promising outlook

highlights: Notably, revenue for the paints segment dropped 20% QoQ (12% below forecast) while losses for ‘paints + B2b e-commerce’ combined stood at ~INR 3.2bn (vs.
Overall EBITDA declined 48% QoQ (though was up 35% YoY) and fared 6% below our estimate.

Yet, the outlook appears promising, stemming from Grasim’s confidence to 1) target 50% YoY revenue growth for paints in H2FY27 (backed by record sales in Oct’26) and 2) achieve breakeven in B2B e-commerce, also in H2FY27.
While the weakness seen in chemicals business and the deeper losses in paints (owing to higher crude oil costs), triggered an 11% cut to our FY27E EBITDA, we see limited risks to our FY28 forecast.
